channel.title: Bounding Into Comics - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bounding Into Comics (boundingintocomics.com)

item.title: 7 Hilarious Anti-Cheat Punishments in Video Games
item.description: While it's fun to break a game with cheats, there are some video games with hilarious anti-cheat punishments to combat this.

item.title: 7 Games With the Hardest Easter Eggs to Find
item.description: Some of the hardest Easter eggs have taken months to years to find, including these seven examples from iconic titles.

item.title: Kaiju History - A Plague Of Rats Ended An Inept Production And Gave The World Gamera
item.description: This month in Kaiju History, find out how an infestation of rats led to Gamera and his parity with Godzilla.

item.title: 'Andor' Sets Record For 'Star Wars' Production Budgets, Pretty Much Guaranteeing Disney Never Takes A Swing Ever Again
item.description: A new filing has confirmed 'Andor' had the largest budget of any 'Star Wars' project - which means Disney is probably done with creativity.

item.title: ‘Frankenstein’ Review – A Bloated Celebration Of Ravenous Overacting, Ostentatious Over-Stylizing, And Monochromatic Overkill
item.description: Review: Is Guillermo Del Toro's take on 'Frankenstein' a modern masterpiece or more of the upscale but gaudy writhing of 'Nosferatu'?

item.title: If You Think 'Magic: The Gathering' Is Turning To "Slop," Its Head Designer Thinks You Might Be A Fascist
item.description: Though the term is apt, 'Magic: The Gathering' head designer Mark Rosewater views anyone using the term 'slop' to be flirting with fascists.

item.title: After Declaring Partnership Sales As Revenue, Ubisoft Used Tencent Money To Make Amends For Breaching Loan Agreement
item.description: After incorrectly reporting their financials, Ubisoft repayed a loan early to make amends, using Tencent's investment into Vantage Studios.

item.title: 'Sarah’s Oil' Review: A New Chapter for Zachary Levi?
item.description: Review: 'Sarah’s Oil' is a "faith-based" indie film featuring Zachary Levi that seeks to inspire with its story.

item.title: BIC's New Ask-Me-Anything Series Kicks Off Tomorrow As The Rippaverse's Andrew Rodriguez Stops By To Talk 'Blue-Shift'
item.description: In service of celebrating comic books, BIC is launching a new 'Ask-Me-Anything' series - Our first guest? The Rippaverse's Andrew Rodriguez.

item.title: 'Super Sentai' Ending Officially Confirmed - Make Way For 'PROJECT R.E.D.' And A New 'Space Sheriff Gavan'
item.description: With 'Super Sentai's ending, Toei pass the tokusatsu torch to 'PROJECT R.E.D' and its first entry, 'Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity'
